title: Improving critical buildings energy resilience via shared autonomous electric vehicles -- A sequential optimization framework
summary: The interdependence between electric power systems and transportation systems is rapidly increasing due to the high adoption of Electric Vehicles (EVs) and their charging infrastructures. Electric vehicles can represent additional load for the power system, but can also bring new opportunities for contributing to the efficient and resilient operations of the power grid. This is mainly because of their ability to provide back power to the system when it is not used for transportation, essentially serving as a moving battery source for the power grid.
